target_status: Operational targets remain unset pending measured full-size recovery and agreed operating requirements. Local archive round-trip duration is not an RTO or an RPO.

implemented_partial.scope: Explicit synthetic file encryption/decryption, at most 64 MiB plaintext; no database or network access
implemented_partial.encryption: AES-256-GCM, fresh random 96-bit nonce, 128-bit authentication tag, authenticated version header, separate 256-bit key
implemented_partial.restore_guards: Authenticate before creating output; create-only 0600 destination; refuse existing files, final-component symlinks and identical input/output/key paths
implemented_partial.verified: Exact synthetic role/job/audit/attachment bundle bytes survive the wrapper; tamper, wrong-key, truncation and overwrite checks fail safely

existing_database_rehearsal: tools/accounting-flow/restore-drill.mjs verifies plaintext pg_dump restore within the disposable test cluster, including accounting/source content fingerprints and existing runtime role restrictions. It does not prove encrypted offsite recovery or reconstruct cluster roles in a new cluster.
remaining: Connect encryption to the disposable PostgreSQL dump/restore workflow under an explicit runner file lease, preserving original source and verifying restored fingerprint.
Restore roles, grants, database, original attachments, durable jobs and audit evidence into an independently created disposable cluster.
Measure representative end-to-end recovery duration and point-in-time data loss before setting operational targets.
Assign backup/restore/key ownership and define key rotation, emergency recovery, retention and deletion evidence.
Provision off-site destination/access only through the P03-80 owner gate; no provider is connected by this utility.
